fields.Volume: Bi-monthly sale events + monthly hot deals (per §13.3)

workflows.name: Bundle Promotion Execution, Price Override & POS Application

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logic, price, validity, channel scope, and loyalty applicability" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "IT/POS deploy price change to POS" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor promotion execution" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Deployment risk**: Promotion not applied at POS or channel; mitigated by pre-launch test transactions
System Touchpoints: - Price book (links to W40); POS deployment (links to VS-08); ecommerce/marketplace price sync (links to VS-10/VS-65)

steps.activity: Pricing configures bundle promotion in price book (links to W40): bundle SKU/promo logic, price, validity, channel scope, and loyalty applicability
IT/POS deploy price change to POS (600 terminals) and ecommerce/marketplace (links to VS-08/VS-10/VS-65); validate price applies correctly at scan
Pricing/Store Ops monitor promotion execution; handle price overrides per authorization (links to POS-010); correct configuration errors

fields.Trigger: Quantity-break or tiered bundle pricing configured

workflows.name: Dynamic Bundle Pricing, Quantity Break & Tier Execution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logic in POS/ecommerce" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews tier uptake and margin impact" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
- operational: margin floors and post-launch review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin-erosion risk**: Aggressive tiers erode margin; mitigated by margin floors and post-launch review
System Touchpoints: - Quantity-break pricing (links to POS-010); tier rule engine; margin analytics

steps.activity: Pricing Analyst defines quantity-break/tier rules (e.g., buy 10+ get 5% off, tiered bundle pricing) and margin floors per W3067
IT/POS configure tier logic in POS/ecommerce; validate tier triggers correctly at threshold quantities
Pricing reviews tier uptake and margin impact; adjusts thresholds to optimize volume vs. margin

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document in vendor agreement" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "file claim/evidence to vendor" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track co-op realization vs." (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery risk**: Earned allowance not claimed or disputed by vendor; mitigated by evidence-based claims and tracking
System Touchpoints: - Vendor rebate/allowance (links to VS-39); AP claim; vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: Vendor Mgmt/Trade Marketing negotiate vendor-funded bundle allowance and co-op terms; document in vendor agreement (links to VS-39)
Finance/AP compute allowance earned from bundle sell-through; file claim/evidence to vendor; reconcile to AP per VS-39
Vendor Mgmt pursue recovery; track co-op realization vs. deal; feed into vendor scorecard and next-cycle negotiation (links to VS-67)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Merchandising/Pricing act on findings" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cannibalization risk**: Bundle appears successful but displaces higher-margin standalone; mitigated by net-incremental analysis
System Touchpoints: - Merchandising analytics (links to VS-28/VS-44); basket/cannibalization model

steps.activity: Merchandising Analytics produce kit/bundle sell-through: units, revenue, sell-through rate, attach rate (bundle vs. component standalone), by channel
Merchandising Analytics assess cannibalization: bundle sales displacing component standalone sales; net incremental revenue/margin
Merchandising/Pricing act on findings (expand/cut bundles, adjust pricing); feed decisions to portfolio review (W3088)

workflows.name: Bundle Margin Analysis, Component Contribution & Profitability

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze component contribution" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-cost risk**: Build labor/shrink not in kit cost understates true margin; mitigated by full-cost roll-up
System Touchpoints: - Margin analytics (links to W85/VS-28); component cost roll-up; vendor negotiation (links to VS-03)

steps.activity: FP&A computes realized bundle margin: revenue vs. rolled-up component cost (incl. build labor and shrink); by kit and channel
FP&A/Merchandising analyze component contribution: which components drive cost/margin; identify low-margin or high-cost components for renegotiation
Pricing/Merchandising act to restore margin (price adjust, component substitute, vendor renegotiation, discontinue) per W3072/W3067

workflows.name: Customer Bundle Uptake, Basket Analysis & Cross-Sell Optimization

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze bundle uptake by customer segment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "identify cross-sell opportunities and new bundle concepts from basket affinity" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-measure of "Loyalty/CRM target high-affinity customers with relevant bundle offers" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Irrelevance risk**: Bundles that don't match customer needs; mitigated by segment affinity analysis
System Touchpoints: - Consumer insights (links to VS-44); loyalty/CRM targeting (links to VS-13); basket analytics

steps.activity: Consumer Insights analyze bundle uptake by customer segment (B2C, trade, project), basket composition, and cross-sell patterns (links to VS-44)
Merchandising/Marketing identify cross-sell opportunities and new bundle concepts from basket affinity; test via pilots
Loyalty/CRM target high-affinity customers with relevant bundle offers (links to VS-13); measure uplift

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-collect of "collect competitor bundle offerings, pricing, and promotion timing" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "Merchandising/Pricing benchmark BuildRight bundles vs. competitors" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Pricing/Merchandising decide response" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Competitive-blindness risk**: Missing competitor bundles; mitigated by regular intelligence cycle
System Touchpoints: - Competitive price intelligence (links to VS-57); pricing response (links to W3081)

steps.activity: Competitive Intelligence collect competitor bundle offerings, pricing, and promotion timing (links to VS-57)
Merchandising/Pricing benchmark BuildRight bundles vs. competitors (value, composition, price); identify gaps/advantages
Pricing/Merchandising decide response (match, differentiate, ignore); execute via W3081; monitor competitor counter-response

fields.Participants: VP Merchandising, Merchandising Analytics, Pricing, Marketing, Supply Chain

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile portfolio scorecard" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "VP Merchandising/Pricing review portfolio" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-communication of "communicate changes to DC/Store Ops and Marketing" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-507 (ensure controlled execution — Bundle Pricing, Promotion & Performance Analytics (PA-92.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Portfolio-bloat risk**: Too many low-value kits dilute focus and inventory; mitigated by quarterly rationalization
System Touchpoints: - Portfolio scorecard (links to VS-28); assortment planning (links to VS-01); build planning (links to W3069)

steps.activity: Merchandising Analytics compile portfolio scorecard: sell-through, margin, cannibalization, attach, vendor allowance realization per kit
VP Merchandising/Pricing review portfolio: grow winners, fix/adjust mid-tier, discontinue underperformers (W3072); rationalize overlap
Merchandising/Supply Chain align next-cycle build plan to optimized portfolio; communicate changes to DC/Store Ops and Marketing
